name: Gaussian-based Representation
definition: A method that encodes signals, data, or geometric structure as an explicit, continuous sum (or mixture) of parameterized Gaussian functions, enabling efficient, closed-form operations for various high-dimensional applications.
summary: Gaussian-based representation encodes data as a sum of parameterized Gaussian functions, distinguishing itself through explicit, analytically differentiable primitives that enable efficient closed-form operations.
